Author: Bao Yonggang  Editor: Lin Juemin  
In recent years, the PC processor market has seen a long-absent state of intense competition. The once relatively stable competitive landscape has been reshaped by Apple’s M-series processors, which redefined perceptions of PC energy efficiency. AMD has also intensified its offensive, and with the rise of the AI PC concept, Intel is facing significant competitive pressure.  
Over two months ago, Intel first detailed the architecture of its third-generation Core Ultra processors (codenamed Panther Lake) at ITT 25. This new generation of AI PC platforms, combining high performance and energy efficiency, has become a key product for Intel to maintain its leadership in the PC market.  
During CES 2026, Intel CEO Chen Liwu shared, "By the end of 2025, we successfully shipped the first product based on the Intel 18A process. Moreover, we delivered results beyond expectations—at this moment, all chip packages of the third-generation Core Ultra series have achieved mass production."  
The mass production of Intel 18A is the cornerstone of Intel’s ability to maintain leadership in the AI PC market. During CES, OEMs such as Lenovo, Dell, Asus, and MSI showcased laptops equipped with the latest third-generation Core Ultra processors.

La estructura competitiva, antes relativamente estable, ha sido transformada por los procesadores M de Apple, que han redefinido la percepción sobre la eficiencia energética en las PC. AMD también ha intensificado su ofensiva, y junto con el auge del concepto de PC con IA, Intel se enfrenta a una considerable presión competitiva. Hace más de dos meses, Intel ya presentó en el ITF 25 los detalles arquitectónicos de la tercera generación de procesadores Intel Core Ultra (con nombre en clave Panther Lake), posicionando esta nueva plataforma de PC con IA, que combina alto rendimiento y eficiencia energética, como un producto clave para mantener su liderazgo en el mercado de PC. items.title: 对话何小鹏：今年自动驾驶能力提升10倍，推出四款全新SUV全球车
items.raw_excerpt: 过去一年，小鹏的表现不多见，在行业普遍承压、价格与配置被卷到极限的阶段，小鹏汽车的全年交付反而超过40万台。 在近日的全球新品发布会上，小鹏汽车更是发布四款新车，价格覆盖18万-30万元，有意追击更高销量。销量增长来自产品结构的调整。小鹏开始从“单点突破”转向“多车型协同”，将纯电与增程纳入同一套平台体系。在小鹏汽车看来，当纯电续航已长期稳定在 600–800 公里区间，继续堆电池带来的边际价值正在下降，真正拉开体验差距的，是能耗控制、使用效率以及背后的智能系统。 近日，小鹏汽车与中外媒体的对话中，小鹏汽车董事长、CEO何小鹏春风满面，他把2025年概括为“稳进破局”。在他的叙述里，小鹏汽车的关键词正从“活下来”变成“跑得更远”。 小鹏对全球化的理解发生了变化。谈到汽车出口，何小鹏更多强调本地研发制造、左右舵同步开发，而非过去常提的渠道拓展、认证合规与价格竞争。 “我们正进入一个真正全球化发展的阶段。”何小鹏透露，2026年，小鹏汽车不仅与大众合作的首款车型将第二季度在中国量产，还将开拓美洲市场，新建海外工厂。 2026年，是小鹏汽车发展史上的一个分水岭，告别了“行稳致远”的稳健运营策略，成为小鹏汽车物理AI落地关键三年的元年。何小鹏表示，无论海内外市场，小鹏汽车都将围绕 AI 范式转型、基础设施建设等方向推进。 自动驾驶依旧被视为小鹏汽车产品的核心竞争点。小鹏汽车计划，利用同一套 VLA，分别应用于量产车自动驾驶以及Robotaxi。目前，小鹏汽车已在欧洲进行道路测试，今年或将在欧洲推出成熟的自动驾驶软件。 在这一逻辑下，何小鹏也在重新调整海外市场销量目标。去年，小鹏海外销量占比约为 10%，长期来看海外市场的增速有机会快于国内，希望在更长周期内，让海外的销量规模、合作深度与能力输出，与中国市场形成 1:1 甚至更高的比例。 当然，小鹏汽车的全球化布局远不止于汽车。202

excerpt_i18n.en: Over the past year, XPeng's performance has been exceptional. Amid widespread industry pressure and intense competition over pricing and configurations, the company delivered over 400,000 vehicles for the full year. At its recent global new product launch, XPeng unveiled four new models priced between 180,000 and 300,000 yuan, aiming for even higher sales. This growth stems from adjustments to its product lineup, shifting from a "single breakthrough" strategy to "multi-model synergy," integrating both pure electric and extended-range vehicles into a unified platform. XPeng believes that with pure electric range now consistently between 600 and 800 kilometers, the marginal value of adding more batteries is diminishing. What truly differentiates the user experience is energy consumption control, efficiency, and the underlying intelligent systems. In recent discussions with domestic and international media, XPeng's Chairman and CEO, He Xiaopeng, appeared confident, describing 2025 as a year of "steady progress and breakthrough." In his narrative, XPeng's focus is shifting from "survival" to "going further." The company's approach to globalization has also evolved. When discussing vehicle exports, He now emphasizes local R&D and manufacturing, as well as simultaneous development of left- and right-hand drive models, rather than the previously highlighted channel expansion, certification compliance, and price competition. "We are entering a phase of genuine global development," He revealed, noting that in 2026, XPeng will not only begin mass production of its first co-developed model with Volkswagen in China in the second quarter but also expand into the Americas and establish overseas factories. For XPeng, 2026 marks a turning point, moving beyond the steady and cautious strategy of "proceeding steadily for long-term success."
excerpt_i18n.es: El año pasado, el desempeño de Xpeng fue excepcional. En un período en el que la industria en general enfrentaba presiones y los precios y configuraciones llegaban a su límite, la empresa logró entregar más de 400.000 vehículos en todo el año. En su reciente lanzamiento global de nuevos productos, Xpeng presentó cuatro modelos nuevos, con precios que van desde 180.000 hasta 300.000 yuanes, con la intención de alcanzar mayores ventas. Este crecimiento en ventas proviene de un ajuste en la estructura de productos. Xpeng ha comenzado a pasar de un "enfoque único" a una "colaboración entre múltiples modelos", integrando vehículos eléctricos puros y de autonomía extendida en una misma plataforma. Según Xpeng, dado que la autonomía de los eléctricos puros se ha estabilizado en el rango de 600 a 800 kilómetros, el valor marginal de añadir más baterías está disminuyendo. Lo que realmente marca la diferencia en la experiencia es el control del consumo energético.
